audience: teams that collect form submissions with Formspark

useCases.title: Search submissions across a workspace
useCases.text: List the workspaces, then list the newest submissions across all forms of one workspace. Search them for a word, such as an invoice number.

useCases.title: Review the submissions of one form
useCases.text: List the forms of a workspace, then list the newest submissions of one form. Read the field values and timestamps of each one.

useCases.title: Check where a form sends its notifications
useCases.text: Get one form by id, with its settings and the email addresses that receive its notifications.

useCases.title: Create a form with notification emails
useCases.text: Create a form in a workspace with a name, a description and notification emails. Later, update its name, notification emails or threading.

useCases.title: Check what the connection can read
useCases.text: Describe the API token, with its name, scopes and expiry. Then list the workspaces that the token can reach.
